scenario: Precise geolocation data collected for navigation is used for a purpose the user did not consent to (for example marketing).
owner: Risk owner (a role, not a named individual)

inherent.rationale: Location data is available to several services and attractive for secondary use. Impact is severe for regulatory exposure and user harm.

control.name: Purpose limitation gate on all reads of precise geolocation

tolerance: Medium or below without owner sign-off
